caption:
Owen Thiele is starring in a brand new Tinder ad for Group Hangouts, playing a nature documentary narrator who watches people date in the wild. The best part? He has been with his boyfriend for ten years.

Would you let your coupled-up friends set you up on a group date? 📱👀
